title: Ciphertext-only post-terminal-moduli residue balance prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only residue-balance rule for moduli 55 through 61 before scoring any future source-backed observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only K4 ciphertext positions, a fixed non-anchor exclusion mask, and a deterministic post-terminal modulus residue-selection rule; it does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment match counts.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared post-terminal-modulus residue-balance classes before any candidate-word, route, key-material, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Public K4 ciphertext only, interpreted as one-based absolute ciphertext positions
Fixed non-anchor position universe emitted by the repo before any observation scoring
For each modulus 55 through 61, select the non-anchor residue class with the highest distinct ciphertext-letter rate
Tie-break by larger position count and then lower residue number
No candidate words, key material, routes, plaintext guesses, additive fragment values, or source-backed observation positions used to construct the target
evaluation_inputs: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale declared before scoring
A committed prediction artifact generated from the post-terminal-moduli residue-balance rule before evaluating independent observations
Observation files whose scored positions were not used to construct or tune the residue-balance prediction artifact
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-modulus null over every predeclared modulus 55 through 61 and its selected residue class
ciphertext-symbol shuffle baseline preserving K4 length and alphabet membership
known public-anchor positions used only as an exclusion mask, not as scoring evidence or tuning input
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes required before interpretation
archive validation requiring preregistration, prediction artifact, source-backed observation file, command metadata, and non-promotion caveat
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
